resources.title: Production-Grade foundry.toml Template
resources.description: A real foundry.toml starter covering everything Chapter 1 and Chapter 3 depend on: tuned fuzz and invariant settings (including a slower, wider `ci` profile distinct from the fast local default), named RPC endpoint aliases, and per-chain Etherscan-family verification keys. Fill in the bracketed env vars and drop it straight into a new Foundry project.

resources.title: Gated GitHub Actions Workflow for Foundry Projects
resources.description: A complete ci.yml running forge fmt/build/test (with a separate 10,000-run fuzz / 1,000-run invariant CI profile), Solhint linting, and Slither static analysis as three distinct jobs — ready to add as required branch-protection checks exactly as Lesson 11 describes.

resources.title: Mainnet Pre-Launch Checklist
resources.description: Lesson 26's full checklist as a reusable Markdown document, every item traced back to the lesson it came from, plus the two items the course deliberately leaves off (audit, bug bounty) with a pointer to Lesson 27. Copy it for every real deployment.

resources.title: On-Chain Incident Response Runbook
resources.description: A fill-in-the-blanks runbook built from Chapter 5: severity-based alert routing, the confirm-before-you-pause decision steps, a sample first public message that commits to a timeframe without over-claiming, and a postmortem template. Meant to be rehearsed before an incident, not written during one.
